name: Palaces and Parks of Potsdam and Berlin
description: Along the River Havel and Lake Glienicke, southwest of Berlin, this sweeping chain of royal parks holds about 150 buildings erected between 1730 and 1916. Roughly 500 hectares of gardens link the palaces, from Potsdam into Berlin's Zehlendorf district. Its best-known stop is Sanssouci, the summer retreat Frederick II built in the 1740s, where Voltaire once stayed as a guest.
